title: Microsoft 365 outage (Exchange Online incident from 9:47 pm IST Thu 12 Nov 2026, per Microsoft) knocks out Outlook, parts of Teams, Copilot and SharePoint; Downdetector: reports reached 74 countries and territories in about an hour, India's rose tenfold by 11:21 pm IST, peak 19,650 a minute across five services at 11:55 pm IST, Outlook alone 1 lakh+ at peak; Microsoft blames servers failing automated health checks, no indication of a cyberattack; not declared fixed as of 7:55 am IST Fri ('positive results' restarting servers, no ETA); admin incident EX1550543, backup status page status.cloud.microsoft
